description: A white phone and a coiled white charging cable lie on a dark blue bedspread in front of a large pillow. The left hand reaches in and picks up the cable tip while the right hand slides the phone closer, then the left hand guides the connector into the phone’s port as the right hand steadies the phone as a right-hand object; after it’s seated, the right hand lets go and the phone rests on the bed with the cable attached.
